summary: Tested SESSION 6 (Travel Goals CRUD) backend + Transactions badges (categoria/Validada/Auto) frontend on https://objetivo-financiero.preview.emergentagent.com with admin earauzt@gmail.com. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests PASS. Frontend: badges render perfectly with correct slate/emerald styling and data-testids. /metas-viaje route redirects to /viajes (page loads, shows goal tipo selector and goal rows with action icons). Backend annual_budget for Travel Fund got polluted to $1.00 by an older test (cosmetic, not a bug).

verified_endpoints: POST /api/travel-goals — creates goal with tipo='educacion' persisted correctly
GET /api/travel-goals — returns goals[] with monthly_needed, days_remaining, progress_percent, total_spent calculated
POST /api/travel-goals/{id}/add-savings — increments saved_amount; returns 400 on amount<=0
POST /api/travel-goals/{id}/link-transaction — appends to linked_transactions, updates tx.linked_goal_id + linked_goal_name; 400 if no transaction_id; 404 if tx not found
GET /api/travel-goals/{id}/transactions — returns {transactions, total} matching list endpoint total_spent

transactions_badges.tx_category: PASS — 105/105 rows have data-testid='tx-category-{id}'. Sample: 'Servicios Basicos · General'. Computed styles: bg=rgb(241,245,249)=slate-100, color=rgb(71,85,105)=slate-600, border=slate-200, rounded-full. Subcategoria correctly rendered with ' · ' separator.
transactions_badges.tx_validated: PASS — 99 rows show 'Validada' badge with data-testid='tx-validated-{id}'. Computed styles: bg=rgb(236,253,245)=emerald-50, color=rgb(4,120,87)=emerald-700, border emerald-200.
transactions_badges.tx_auto: PASS — 33 rows show 'Auto' badge with gear icon, data-testid='tx-auto-{id}'. Slate styling matches spec.

metas_viaje_page.url: /metas-viaje silently redirects to /viajes (sidebar nav-viajes); page renders with data-testid='viajes-page'
metas_viaje_page.render: PASS — Hero shows Meta Anual 2026 / Ya Ahorrado / Gastado / Disponible. Tabs Destinos | Por Categoria | Transacciones present. 4 existing goals listed: Navidad/Entretenimiento/Test Destination 24c1/Test Destination 3630, each with tipo badge ('Viaje'), days_remaining, target_date, monthly_needed text ('Ahorrar $X/mes') and progress bar. Page has 4 action icons per goal row (link/piggy/edit/trash) — these are icon-only buttons with no visible 'Vincular' text label.
metas_viaje_page.vincular_button_text_search: 0 buttons match /vincular/i — feature is exposed via icon button only, no accessible label or visible text 'Vincular gasto'.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Vincular gasto' is rendered as an icon-only button with no aria-label / visible text, making it hard to discover. Spec specifically called out 'botón Vincular gasto abre diálogo de búsqueda'. Add aria-label='Vincular gasto' or a tooltip with data-testid='link-tx-{goal_id}'.

'Meta Anual 2026 = $1,00' and progress 272650% — pre-existing pollution from prior test_travel_fund.py run leaving annual_budget=1. Not introduced by this session, but distorts UI. Run PUT /api/travel-fund/settings {annual_budget: 16500} to restore.

issues: Badges render exactly as spec: slate category pill + emerald 'Validada' + slate 'Auto' with gear icon. Visual confirmation in screenshot.

action_items: Add accessible label / tooltip / data-testid to the Vincular gasto icon button in MetasViaje.js (lines 456-542) so QA can target it and screen readers can describe it.
Optional cosmetic: restore admin's Travel Fund annual_budget to a realistic value (e.g. $16500) — currently $1.00 due to previous test_travel_fund.py mutation.
critical_code_review_comments: cashflow.py /travel-goals/{id}/link-transaction — does not check for duplicate goal-link from another goal: a transaction could be linked to multiple goals simultaneously, double-counting in total_spent. Consider unlinking from any prior goal before re-linking.

cashflow.py PUT /travel-goals/{id} accepts an unbounded dict — no whitelist of allowed fields, so a malicious payload could overwrite user_id, id, saved_amount, status. Restrict to {destination, target_amount, target_date, tipo, notes}.
cashflow.py /travel-goals total_spent is recomputed in GET but stored as 0 in POST — never persisted; minor inconsistency. The list view recalculates correctly via aggregation.
cashflow.py monthly_needed formula uses days_remaining/30 — for goals <30 days remaining returns >= remaining/1 which can be huge; consider clamping or labeling as 'urgente'.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (badges 3/3 PASS; MetasViaje page loads & functional but Vincular button lacks discoverable label)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Educacion Hijo (tipo=educacion) and TEST_DeleteMe goals — both deleted by fixture teardown / explicit DELETE.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Travel Goals fully verified via pytest (test_session6_travel_goals.py). Transactions badges (Validada/Auto/categoria) verified visually with 99 Validada and 33 Auto badges across 105 rows. /metas-viaje URL is actually mounted at /viajes (see sidebar nav-viajes). The Vincular feature exists but is an icon-only button — main agent should add an aria-label or visible 'Vincular' text + data-testid='link-tx-{goal_id}' for future automated testing. Admin's Travel Fund annual_budget is currently $1 due to old test mutation; not a regression.
rca of the issue: No bugs. The 'missing Vincular button' is a discoverability issue — the JSX in MetasViaje.js lines 456-542 likely renders an icon-only Button (probably with Link/Paperclip/Search lucide icon) without a child text node or aria-label, so text-based selectors return 0. Recommend adding aria-label and data-testid for testability.
